effects.notes: With Day Laborer and the adjacent Lessons both unoccupied, one of your people may use both spaces in this order; both then count as occupied.

review.notes: Cost: free. Prerequisite: must not have played any occupation (wiki: 職業を出していない). Encoded as occupation_count n=0. Effect: when Day Laborer and adjacent Lessons are both unoccupied, one person may use both spaces in order; both count as occupied. Verified via BGA Wiki (wiki_verified - simple card with established occupation_count predicate). Source: https://agricola.cloudfree.jp/?p=3066 (ja, 2026-11-16). 条件：職業を出していない。コスト：なし。効果：アクションスペース「日雇い労働者」とその隣の「授業」が両方とも未占有の場合、人物1人で両方をこの順で使用できる。プレイエリアに残る。
